summary: TTL commit staggering causes tenant to bounce between canary and stable variants (intermittent fallback loop)
description: Issue summary: During a staged canary rollout for redwood-open-7B-v2 in the BrightHealth dedicated fleet, a staggered TTL commit across edge shards caused a small cohort of tenant sessions to lose pin-coherence. Impact: affected tenant sessions experienced repeated fallback between the canary variant and the stable variant, resulting in increased tail latency, duplicated token outputs for streaming sessions, and sporadic 5xx errors. Scope: limited to BrightHealth AI customers on the dedicated pool in us-east-1; first observed after a canary weight increase at 2026-03-10T09:22:00Z.
steps_to_reproduce:
1) Configure a weighted canary rollout (10% -> 40%) for redwood-open-7B-v2 with edge shard TTLs set to staggered commit windows.
2) Initiate traffic from tenant with long-lived streaming sessions.
3) Observe routing logs on edge and control plane when canary weight crosses the health-window boundary.
4) Reproduce by simulating intermittent rate-limit 429 responses from a single edge shard while health probes continue to report 'healthy'.
recent_logs:
[2026-03-10T09:22:15Z] edge-ash-12 INFO route-decide tenant=brighthealth sess=abc123 pinned=stable -> candidate=canary weight=0.10
[2026-03-10T09:22:18Z] controlplane-commit INFO commit-ttl tenant=brighthealth shard=ash-12 ttl=30s commit-window=2026-03-10T09:22:18Z
[2026-03-10T09:22:19Z] edge-ash-12 WARN request=xyz 429 rate_limit exceeded
[2026-03-10T09:22:21Z] edge-ash-12 INFO route-decide tenant=brighthealth sess=abc123 pinned=canary -> fallback=stable reason=fallback-on-retry
[2026-03-10T09:22:23Z] stream-xyz ERROR token-duplication detected tokens=+2 session=abc123
[2026-03-10T09:22:25Z] controlplane INFO reconcile tenant=brighthealth pin-consistency=unstable
investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: staggered TTL commit across edge shards allowed control-plane to see mixed pin states for same tenant during rapid weight adjustments.

Edge shard ash-12 returned intermittent 429s which triggered client-side retry logic and the edge route decision returned a fallback to stable variant while control-plane commit for canary was in-flight.
We observed pin metadata TTL differences by ~2-6s between ash-12 and ash-14 during the window; this matched the timing of the fallback loop.
No code-level bug in routing algorithm was found; the race is between commit propagation and edge retry/fallback heuristics under throttling.
Related config: control-plane commit-window default=5s, edge retry backoff=250ms x 3, pin-ttl=30s.
temporary_workaround:
1) For affected tenants, set explicit model pin on the tenant route (pin: redwood-open-7B-v2-stable) to force stable serving while we remediate propagation timing.
2) Reduce canary weight ramp-up steps and increase commit-window to 15s to avoid in-flight mismatch.
3) Apply per-edge backpressure smoothing to prevent 429-triggered immediate fallback.
resolution_notes: In progress: control-plane patch proposed to add commit monotonic fencing (PR linked) and edge fallback heuristic adjusted to wait for in-flight commit acknowledgement when commit timestamps are newer than local pin TTL. Long-term: add explicit pin-sync protocol between control-plane and edge to avoid TTL stagger races. Target: patch to be deployed to staging 2026-03-13 and prod 2026-03-14 after validation.
comments: 2026-03-10T10:01:00Z - Support (Mei Chen): Received report from BrightHealth CS about intermittent token duplication and increased latency after canary ramp. Customer reported approx 7 affected sessions; provided sample session ids.

2026-03-10T10:22:30Z - SRE (Evan Coleman): Collected edge shard metrics and found short-lived 429 spikes on ash-12 correlated with commit windows. Reproduced locally with simulated 429s; fallback loop reproduced.

2026-03-10T11:05:12Z - Engineering (Priya Narang): Added instrumentation to control-plane commit path to log commit-timestamp and shard acknowledgements. Observed 4-6s propagation skew between shards in prod under current commit-window.

2026-03-10T11:45:00Z - Support (Mei Chen) -> Customer (BrightHealth AI): Applied temporary explicit pin and reduced rollout speed; customer reports immediate reduction in duplication. Asking customer for confirmation of service level for remainder of business day.

2026-03-11T09:10:00Z - SRE (Evan Coleman): Deployed emergency config change to increase commit-window to 15s for ongoing canaries in us-east-1. Rollout monitored; no further fallback loops observed in 6h post-change.
2026-03-12T14:20:00Z - Engineering (Priya Narang): Opened control-plane PR to add commit fencing and edge acknowledgement path. Requesting review and staging verification.
